'''Hendr "Guns" T'uik''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Hendr T'uik frequently raided the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] in their [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk interceptor]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempBlackSunSpaceComm.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Hendr T'uik]]
Hendr T'uik appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hendr T'uik was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Hendr "Guns" T'uik was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Valarian starfighters in the Dantooine system.<ref name="SWG:DS" />
